svg.aria-label: Most common owner complaints about robot vacuums, ranked qualitatively

g.text: What owners complain about most (recent 1–3★ reviews and owner threads)
Occasional
Common
Very common
Hair wrapped on the brush roll / side brush
Worst with long human hair. Split/dual rollers, bristle-free brushes and hair-cutting combs help; nothing eliminates it.
Stuck on cords, rug fringe, chair legs
Camera + LiDAR flagships cut this dramatically; bump-navigation budget bots suffer most. Threshold-climbing chassis solve the door-sill case.
Dock port clogs / loses suction over time
Pet-hair homes. Check the bin-to-dock port monthly; bagless cyclone docks need their cyclone cleared too.
Mop odor / dirty-water tank smell
Docks without hot-air drying, and owners who leave the dirty tank for days. Hot-water wash + heated dry docks get far fewer of these reviews.
Navigation quirks and ignored no-go zones
Usually after map edits or a firmware update; a fresh map fixes most cases. Multi-floor homes report it more.
Run time far below the claim on carpet
Claims are measured in quiet mode on hard floor. Expect 40–60% of the headline minutes in max mode on carpet.
App, 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi setup, firmware regressions
Narwal and Ecovacs apps draw the most criticism in reviews; Roborock the least. Every brand needs a 2.4 GHz network during setup.
Customer support and warranty turnaround
Ecovacs is the most-cited; iRobot support is in flux after its 2025 bankruptcy and 2026 change of ownership. Buying via Amazon adds Amazon's own return window.
Qualitative ranking from the recent Amazon 1–3★ reviews and Reddit owner threads we read for the products in this guide — a tally of themes, not a statistical survey.
